p2.comparison: identical frozen 15 old pools, 5 historical arms and one conservative role shadow. First source query reserves an earlier undercovered A/neutral role, second considers D/B; no gate times or asset-specific predictions.

constraints: No prior scene label or evaluation annotation reaches AUTO. Oracle uses historic frozen A/B references only; do not export its predictions into downstream.

D0 same-pool line and D1 generic components share frames, cap and verification opportunities. D2 and D3 share the same available roots, no rematch. D3 retrieves second side using existing roots and ranks positive far observations only.

A cannot justify a pixel region from a global match alone. Fit and geometry validators use held coordinates and conservative in-hull masks. Distinct observed views and same-pair reverse dedup. Region explanations may compete; unsupported/outside never indicate absence.

Image-space evidence only, no new scene assignment, Y and physical pose stay null. Source and prediction fixture frozen once; no threshold search. New clips from source only if independent clips exist.
